title: Whole elemental change accounts constrained by typed constituent reassembly
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Timaeus54–56 gives a historical content system in which fire, air and water share one elementary triangle type but earth uses another. A shared variable-length transformation account must preserve both types and obey the written collision/reassembly restrictions. A scalar24-triangle rival wrongly permits earth-to-fire even though the source forbids cross-type conversion. This is neither a copied four-element roster nor an inherited Voynich element assignment.

design.mechanism: Interpret complete hypothetical change accounts through a small fixed inventory of typed constituents, assembly counts, allowable decomposition/reassembly and contextual collision claims. The same type identity persists through every operation, and explanations can assert why one change is permitted or forbidden. A generated meaning may involve arbitrary compatible numbers of bodies and chains of different lengths. No source event count, fixed field serializer or one-unit/one-word relation is chosen.
design.unit: A whole elemental-transformation account, including inputs, environmental conditions, decomposition, products, exceptions and explanations. The supplied source block is54a–56e; a projection limited to the56d–etransformation content must explicitly exclude or separately model the earlier metaphysical, comparative and fifth-figure discussion. It must not claim to translate all source prose while omitting those clauses.
design.contrast: GDT959 retains multiple local geomantic figure/element hypotheses and GDT964 contradicts their uniform one-substitution extension across readers. Those exact reports were read; no old key, ary remainder, four-element orientation or table is adopted. P06/IDEA000124 provide scalar conservation with unresolved material meaning. The present source forces a two-type invariant that scalar conservation alone cannot express. Generic geometry/drawing-operation cards do not make the historical transformation assertion.
design.prediction: Under one shared meaning system, earth fragments may recombine as earth but cannot become fire, air or water merely by preserving an untyped count. Fire/air/water use24,48,120same-type elementary triangles; earth uses24of another type. Therefore scalar24preservation admits earth->fire while typed conservation rejects it. A source-derived two-step chain water->2air+fire->5fire preserves120same-type triangles; water->2air->4fire loses24. Those two-step equations are explicit modern consequences, not extra written source statements.

source_example.content_date: Fourth centuryBCE; accessed edition W.R.M.Lamb1925. No particular pre1450 Greek/Latin witness of the precise block acquired; circulation and source language for a possible target remain unestablished.
complete_56d_56e_change_inventory: Dissolved earth keeps moving until particles reunite as earth; it never changes into another kind.
Water broken by fire or air can become one fire particle and two air particles.
Dissolved air can produce two fire particles.
Two fire particles, defeated and broken amid surrounding material, can form one air particle.
Two-and-a-half air particles can form one water particle.
content_projection_limits: Surrounding material, breaking and defeat conditions are part of the account; an unguarded reversible equation set would omit them.
Earlier pages discuss triangle selection, probable-account qualifications, sizes/mobility/sharpness/stability and the fifth cosmic figure.
The claim is about a historical theory, not modern chemical reactions.

source_receipt.inspection: Complete text layers54,55,56read; no source or target polyhedron image claimed inspected.

symmetries: Consistent renaming of abstract material carriers.
Typed transformation algebra does not itself name literal fire/earth words.
Any additional fine-scale triangle sizes or physical collision rules would need a source-owned finite policy, not per-case tuning.
design.scope: Raw conditional content theory with no admitted target polyhedron or complete transformation-account owner nominated. No default Latin or phonetic model. The typed invariant supplies a different falsifier from four-class similarity, but does not by itself license a complete cipher or identify meanings.
design.writing_model_limits: No source token count, event count, fixed decimal/opcode fields, note-per-word rule, or literal source-order copy is equated with a target paragraph. A globally shared variable-length grammar must account for every content clause and reference within its declared whole-text scope. Explanations and exceptions cannot become free padding. Grammar productions and their written realization remain to be designed before a fit.
design.structural_dependencies: Retain hierarchy at spaces, directed composition, whole-form residuals and position/entry effects from the live baseline. EVA/BPE units are not an identified alphabet. No default Latin/phonetic basis, free deletion of wrappers, or arbitrary per-occurrence semantics.
design.ownership_limit: No complete admitted target owner and shared writing rule are nominated in this source-only card. Joint exploratory owner/code hypotheses remain allowed without a confirmed word; missing concrete observable consequence is a design gap, not a failed manuscript test or proof of absence.
